quest.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Fists of Fury
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Credit Coupons x280

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just what I need!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Ha! Good! You're a straight talker!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Let's go somewhere spacious!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: #You sure left me hanging, {M#lad}{F#lass}. Hope you remember that we weren't finished!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Enough talk. Let's do this!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: #Are you free now, {M#lad}{F#lass}? Spar with me!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Ha! Exhilarating!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: #I knew it, {M#lad}{F#lass}! You're a worthy opponent!

response.speaker: Nizami
response.text: It seems I need to work harder.

response.speaker: Nizami
response.text: Anyway, I'm a straight-shooter, just like you. Here are your Coupons. Let's do this again sometime!

choices.text: You've got some ways to go.

response.speaker: Nizami
response.text: #You don't mince your words, {M#lad}{F#lass}. I like that!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You follow Nizami to the Pankration Ring...

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Young warrior, will you spar with me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, this is super sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: #Whatever you say, {M#lad}{F#lass} with golden hair. I can tell that you're a veteran with just one look.

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: I'm really bored, because no one has been sparring with me. If you will, I'll give you Coupons! I won a lot of those from Roussimoff, and I haven't figured out how to spend them yet.

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: How about it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a pacifist, and I don't like to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: A pacifist that fights violence with violence? To each their own, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: But this is not a fight, we're just sparring. We spar to better protect the peace. So if you're that sort of pacifist, we should definitely spar!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have a point. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Ha! Very good!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Let's go somewhere spacious!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't do it right now. Maybe later.

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: I'll be waiting for you here, then!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: Nice! But let's go somewhere more spacious.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on...

dialogues.speaker: Nizami
dialogues.text: You... Fine, I'll wait for you here.
